operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned to deploy the service on GCP.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Let’s review the deployment plan and confirm the current hosting direction before we finalize the infrastructure work.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Earlier, I planned to deploy the service on GCP.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives us the original baseline. What is the current deployment decision?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I now plan to deploy the service on AWS.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. We should update the provider-specific architecture and check what prompted the change.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The change followed the pricing review.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Let’s make sure the implementation follows the authoritative infrastructure source rather than relying on an informal note.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The deployment target is set in the infra plan.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: We can use that plan as the reference for the deployment configuration. Which technical areas should we review next?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I want to review the service configuration, provisioning changes, and deployment commands.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That scope should help keep the migration consistent across the code and infrastructure layers. Should the review also cover architecture risks?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, include the architecture risks and any provider-specific assumptions.
